title: Presheaves of R-modules on a site: sectionwise kernels and cokernels, and exact sheafification
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $R$ a ring. Let $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ be the category of presheaves of $R$-modules on $\mathcal C$ (functors $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Mod}_R$, morphisms the natural transformations), $\mathrm{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)\subseteq\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ the full subcategory of sheaves of $R$-modules, and $\#:\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)\to\mathrm{Mod}_R(\mathcal C)$, $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P^\#$, the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], left adjoint to the inclusion. Then: (1) $\mathrm{PMod}_R(\mathcal C)$ is an abelian category in which finite limits and finite colimits (in particular kernels, cokernels and images) are computed sectionwise: for every object $U$ the evaluation functor $\mathcal P\mapsto\mathcal P(U)$ to $R$-modules is exact; consequently the $i$-th homology presheaf of a complex $\mathcal K_\bullet$ of presheaves of $R$-modules is $U\mapsto H_i(\mathcal K_\bullet(U))$ with the induced restriction maps; (2) $\#$ commutes with finite limits and (as a left adjoint) with all colimits; hence $\#$ is an exact functor of abelian categories.
